# SYSTEM-ATLAS

<!-- generated by scripts/docs/generate_solo_agent_docs.py; edit source data in srl.labctl -->
SRF is a contract-first scientific computation fabric. It owns
scientific computation, receipts, bounded execution, safe export packets
and standalone documentation. It does not own Market authority, Security
authority, paid credentials, target actions, or physical storage writes.

## Cells

| Cell | Native bootstrap | Transport | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crypto Market Lab bridge | `Market native operator bootstrap` | `D0_D1_spool_packet` | `WAIT_NATIVE_BOOTSTRAP` |
| Security Researcher bridge | `Security native bootstrap` | `D0_D1_spool_packet` | `WAIT_NATIVE_BOOTSTRAP` |
| Standalone SRF session | `srlab doctor` | `local_json` | `READY` |

## Shared Nerves

- Request: `ScientificRequestEnvelope/v1`.
- Result: `ScientificResultEnvelope/v1`.
- Receipt: `ScientificRunReceipt/v1` and import receipts.
- Health: `SRFPulse/v1` plus read-only federation status.
